title: Zesty Velvety Mediterranean Eggplant Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Mediterranean dish featuring tender eggplant, coriander leaves, and a velvety sauce, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is sure to delight your taste buds.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the cubed eggplant and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped coriander leaves, canned tomatoes, vegetable broth, and tomato paste.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Create 4 wells in the tagine and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the Dutch oven and cook until the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional coriander leaves if desired.
